opportunities.name: Paper research: arXiv advanced search, Semantic Scholar lookup, note
opportunities.description: For a topic and year, run an arXiv advanced search, open the top result, look it up on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, and save a summary note.
steps: Open arXiv Search > Advanced search
Enter the topic in the search term box
Tick the date checkbox and choose specific year
Enter the year and click Search
Open the top result
Search the paper title on Semantic Scholar and open it
Read the first author and citation count
Add a note: '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <n> citations'

opportunities.description: For a court case, find it on CourtListener for its citation and decision date, look up a related statute on Cornell LII, and save a note.
steps: Search the case name on CourtListener
Open the case result
Note the citation and decision date
Search the statute citation on Cornell LII
Open the statute page and note its title
Add a note: '<case>: <cite>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)'
